Checking the sofa's bearing from this new position matches its apparent position at u≈373 in the image, though the estimated distance from its base pixel row (about 4.22) is a bit closer than the geometric distance (5.18), likely due to viewing the front face rather than the center. Now checking the stool's position similarly by computing its bearing from the camera.

This contradicts my earlier assumption about the stool's dimensions, so I need to reconsider whether I've identified the object correctly or miscalculated the contact point.

Given my dead reckoning checks out against the corner position, I'm now second-guessing whether the brown object is really stool_1 or if my height estimate for it was mistaken.

I want to verify by measuring the leg contact points against stool_1's mapped position at (-0.90, 5.45), plus check the north wall's top edge for confirmation.
